packages.name: EU Sovereign Starter: Sovereignty Mapping
packages.buyer: EU-regulated organizations facing compliance risks from US cloud providers
packages.outcomeScope: documented deployment and sovereignty plan for a defined workload.
packages.workflow: data-flow mapping, deployment scenario comparison and requirements review.
packages.deliverable: sovereignty roadmap, deployment options, assumptions, risks and open decisions.
packages.inputs: current architecture, data flows and requirements.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: customer-approved roadmap covering the agreed scope.
packages.exclusions: hardware procurement, implementation and third-party integration.

packages.name: EU Sovereign Pilot: Pilot Design and Evaluation
packages.buyer: Organizations wanting to evaluate EU sovereign infrastructure before full commitment
packages.outcomeScope: bounded pilot producing evidence for a customer go/no-go decision.
packages.workflow: pilot definition, data preparation, execution support and results review.
packages.deliverable: pilot report with measured results, limitations and implementation recommendation.
packages.inputs: approved data, evaluation criteria and named customer owner.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed pilot activities completed and results reviewed.

packages.name: Aegis Pilot: Governed Workflow Validation
packages.buyer: Organizations needing to prove operational path for Aegis before procurement
packages.outcomeScope: validation of a defined Aegis workflow in a controlled pilot environment.
packages.workflow: workflow configuration, KYA governance setup, test execution and evidence review.
packages.deliverable: configured pilot workflow, test record and findings report.
packages.inputs: business workflow, test data, decision rules and reviewers.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed test cases executed and limitations documented.
packages.exclusions: production rollout, hardware and external system integration.

packages.name: Aegis: Enterprise Deployment Support
packages.buyer: Organizations requiring single-tenant sovereign AI for dual-use compliance
packages.outcomeScope: defined Aegis deployment supported through implementation and operator handover.
packages.workflow: deployment planning, agreed integration work, configuration, testing and training.
packages.deliverable: deployment record, configured workflows, operator materials and handover report.
packages.inputs: infrastructure, access approvals, integration specifications and customer owner.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed deployment and handover checklist completed.

packages.name: Firehorse Starter Bundle: Climate Data and Report Workflow
packages.buyer: Organizations facing manual compliance reporting that takes weeks
packages.outcomeScope: defined climate-reporting workflow prepared for customer validation.
packages.workflow: source mapping, data preparation, report workflow configuration and evidence review.
packages.deliverable: configured workflow, sample report and source/evidence register.
packages.inputs: ERP/BIM data, reporting boundary and customer review criteria.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed sample data processed and reviewed; gaps documented.
packages.exclusions: data cleansing beyond scope, legal opinions and third-party integration.

packages.name: Climate Intelligence: Climate Data Model
packages.buyer: Organizations with ETS, CBAM and CSRD obligations requiring deterministic execution
packages.outcomeScope: documented climate-data model and reporting support workflow for a defined use case.
packages.workflow: source mapping, model configuration, reporting design and validation review.
packages.deliverable: data model, mapping documentation and example outputs.
packages.inputs: climate data, reporting requirements and source-system access.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed sources mapped and example outputs reviewed.
packages.exclusions: unavailable source data, regulatory certification and third-party integration.

packages.name: Sovereign Database: Architecture and Migration Planning
packages.buyer: Organizations with EU customer data on US-owned cloud as liability
packages.outcomeScope: sovereign database architecture and controlled migration plan.
packages.workflow: architecture review, schema/data assessment, governance design and migration planning.
packages.deliverable: target architecture, migration plan, governance controls and test plan.
packages.inputs: existing schema, data samples, requirements and technical-owner access.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: architecture and migration plan approved for the agreed scope.
packages.exclusions: hardware, full migration execution and third-party integration.

packages.name: Control Room: Operational Workflow Design
packages.buyer: Organizations needing sovereign AI brain that lives in their own building
packages.outcomeScope: defined operational workflow with agreed dashboards and alerts.
packages.workflow: workflow analysis, dashboard design, alert rules and validation.
packages.deliverable: workflow specification, dashboard configuration and alert test record.
packages.inputs: operational requirements, data sources and named operators.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed workflows and alert scenarios demonstrated.
packages.exclusions: hardware and integrations outside the agreed interface scope.

packages.name: Situation Room: Incident Workflow Integration
packages.buyer: Organizations needing two sovereign AI nodes for parallel inference
packages.outcomeScope: defined incident-information workflow with scenario and response documentation.
packages.workflow: data-source mapping, scenario modelling, response workflow design and testing.
packages.deliverable: integration design, scenario set and tested response workflow.
packages.inputs: incident sources, response procedures, roles and test scenarios.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed scenarios executed and findings recorded.
packages.exclusions: emergency operations, hardware and unscoped integrations.

packages.name: DGX Spark: Local AI Environment Setup
packages.buyer: Organizations needing NVIDIA-branded sovereign edge AI for enterprise workloads
packages.outcomeScope: configured local AI development environment for an agreed team and workload.
packages.workflow: environment configuration, model installation, testing and team onboarding.
packages.deliverable: configuration record, installed models, test results and onboarding session.
packages.inputs: DGX Spark access, model requirements and team availability.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed test workload runs and handover is completed.
packages.exclusions: hardware procurement, model licensing and custom application development.

packages.name: IGX Orin: Edge Deployment Support
packages.buyer: Organizations needing industrial-grade sovereign edge AI for medical or nuclear applications
packages.outcomeScope: edge deployment plan and validated installation for an agreed workload.
packages.workflow: hardware planning, installation support, configuration, testing and handover.
packages.deliverable: deployment record, validation results and operational handover.
packages.inputs: device, facility access, network/security requirements and workload definition.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed installation and test cases completed.
packages.exclusions: hardware procurement and unscoped site work.

packages.name: NVIDIA Model Installation: Installation and Handover
packages.buyer: Organizations needing to install sovereign NVIDIA model stack on hardware
packages.outcomeScope: agreed NVIDIA model installed and tested in the specified environment.
packages.workflow: model selection, installation, configuration, testing and documentation.
packages.deliverable: installation record, test results and handover documentation.
packages.inputs: hardware/environment access, model requirements and test cases.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed installation tests pass or exceptions are documented.
packages.exclusions: hardware, model licensing and application development.

packages.name: EU-Sovereign AI Engineering: Fixed-Scope Delivery
packages.buyer: Organizations needing EU-sovereign AI engineering for specific workloads
packages.outcomeScope: defined engineering result supporting deployment, integration or hardening.
packages.workflow: requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing and documentation.
packages.deliverable: agreed engineering output, documentation handover and test record.
packages.inputs: technical requirements, system access and acceptance criteria.
packages.acceptanceBoundary: agreed requirements and test cases completed.
packages.exclusions: hardware, unscoped integrations and open-ended support.
